verdict.rationale: Calendly's own marketing says you can "Charge upfront for meetings, sell packages, and send invoices", and its pricing page lists "Connect Stripe, PayPal". Together these cover collecting payment via Stripe at booking for paid sessions. The evidence is only short marketing and pricing-page claims, with nothing showing how the checkout works. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on the at-booking payment flow (e.g. how checkout ties to the booking, refunds and cancellations), clarity on which plan tier includes payments, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
